The surface is dotted with ruins. Most of them have crates, filing cabinets and loot piles worth checking.

- §6Houses, offices, labs and farmhouses§r in most biomes.
- §6Bunkers§r and §6Fallout Shelter Houses§r.
- §6Vertibirds§r, §6Crashed Planes§r and §6Airplanes§r - the last one with a safe.
- On the coast: §6Beached Patrols§r guarded by turrets, §6Lighthouses§r, §6Oil Rigs§r, a sunken §6Aircraft Carrier§r and §6Submarines§r.
- In snowy biomes: §6Military Bases§r, §6Abandoned Arctic Stations§r and §6Camps§r.
- §6Factories§r, §6Cranes§r, §6Radio Houses§r, §6Broadcasting Towers§r, §6Satellite Dishes§r, §6Water Pumps§r and §6Forest Posts§r.
- In deserts: §6Desert Shacks§r - watch for mines.
- The §6Spire§r - on very flat land, see the quest about it.

Many of them hold an §6FM Radio§r, a tape recorder or a broken turret, which you can take apart.
